page_limit_content.note: 正文（含全部图、表）上限 9 页；参考文献/checklist/技术附录不计入 content pages

evidence.quote: The main text of a submitted paper is limited to nine content pages , including all figures and tables. Additional pages containing references, checklist, and the optional technical appendices do not count as content pages.

references_counted.note: 参考文献页不计入 9 页正文上限

evidence.quote: Additional pages containing references, checklist, and the optional technical appendices do not count as content pages.

appendix_allowed.note: 允许技术附录，可随投稿提交或作为补充材料单独 PDF

evidence.quote: Technical appendices with additional results, figures, graphs and proofs may be submitted with the paper submission before the full submission deadline (see above), or as a separate PDF in the ZIP file below before the supplementary material deadline.

appendix_counted.note: 技术附录无页数限制、不计入正文

evidence.quote: There is no page limit for the technical appendices.

camera_ready_extra_pages.note: 录用后可在 content 页数上再 +1 页

evidence.quote: If your submission is accepted, you will be allowed an additional content page for the camera-ready version.

checklist_required.note: 强制提交 paper checklist（不占页数）

evidence.quote: authors are required to complete a paper checklist

anonymity.note: 投稿须匿名；自引需第三人称；补充材料与代码同样匿名

evidence.quote: All submissions must be anonymized and may not contain any identifying information that may violate the double-blind reviewing policy.

supplementary_policy.value: technical appendices + supplementary material ≤ 100MB, must be anonymized
supplementary_policy.note: 补充材料上限 100MB，且必须匿名

evidence.quote: Authors may submit up to 100MB of technical appendices and supplementary material.

submission_system.note: 审稿意见与作者回复均在 OpenReview forum 上进行

evidence.quote: Author responses may not contain any identifying information that may violate the double-blind reviewing policy. Authors may not submit revisions of their paper or supplemental material, but may post their responses as a discussion in OpenReview.

texopt_requirement_map.note: font_pt 取官方正文 10pt；margin_mm 取等效单边边距 25.4mm（上下 1in；左右 1.5in 更大，texopt 压缩时以下限 margin_min_mm 约束，避免压到不合规）

unsupported_constraints.why: Requirement 无纸张尺寸字段；texopt 不更换纸张
Requirement 无栏数字段；仅用于校验/迁移判断
Requirement.margin_mm 是单一等效值，无法表达非对称边距
page_limit 语义为“总页数”，NeurIPS 的 9 页仅指 content pages（参考文献/附录另计），需 requirements 层支持“计数范围”

recommended_field_suggestions.rationale: 校验编译结果栏数是否与官方模板一致（模板被误改时会破坏合规）
区分“正文页数”与“总页数”，否则 9 页约束会把参考文献页算进去导致过度压缩
NeurIPS/ICLR 等左右边距远大于上下，用单一 margin_mm 会失真
图题在下/表题在上是官方推荐，可作 A 项检查
